name: c409_03_commit_ck_moved
covers: commit CAS, commit key moved: a peer's bulk marker lands between a writer's read of the commit key and its commit-key write; the writer's commit reports a conflict and does not write again at the peer's version

labels.A: begin BULK commit; A: BULK step 1: CA: a: open, bulk: the marker write (bulk-begin), held until b has read the commit key
labels.B: begin ordinary commit; B: upload u; B: b: open, commit: its read of the commit key, then the eleven unit uploads
labels.B: commit CAS -> 409 on commit key; PARK: b: the commit-key write, held until the marker is applied, finds the commit key moved: commit:conflict, nothing written over the marker
